asher_g5: The old hands of R-F18 have been here since Day 1. Ulrich Asher has been here since Day 3. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. From Verdel Ridge the Concord guns have a clear view. Ulrich Asher wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
An empty jam tin became Ulrich Asher's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
